svg.title: C15-M03-F1: Three uses of key pairs
svg.desc: Three rows showing encryption with a recipient's public key, signing with a private key and verifying with the public key, and key agreement producing the same shared secret on both sides.
svg.text: C15-M03-F1 Three uses of key pairs
ENCRYPT/KEM: sender --encrypt with B.public--> ciphertext --B.private--> data key
SIGN: A.private --sign--> signature --verify with A.public--> valid?
KEY AGREEMENT: A.priv + B.pub == B.priv + A.pub -> shared secret -> HKDF
Figure C15-M03-F1. Encryption, signatures and key agreement use key pairs differently.
